name: riem.sammon

mathematical_or_statistical_assumptions: Off-diagonal original distances must be strictly positive. Optimization uses normalized distances, the Sammon diagonal Hessian and descent backtracking.
limitations: No global minimum or class-recovery guarantee. Duplicate observations error because the inverse-distance loss is undefined; no out-of-sample model is supplied.
evidence_scope: Independent loss and derivative calculations, scale and descent checks, duplicate policy and the October 2026 divergence regression fixture.

name: riem.test2wass

evidence_scope: One-dimensional transport reference, extreme weight normalization, singleton matrices, marginals and permutation fixtures.

evidence_scope: Static source and private-dependency review; independent loss/optimizer validation pending.
